questions.question: What is the central correctness invariant of a synchronous distributed training step?
options: Every rank contributes according to the intended batch and synchronization contract before one coherent update is published
Every GPU reports the same utilization percentage
Each rank can apply a partial optimizer update independently
Checkpoint storage is faster than GPU memory
questions.explanation: Distributed execution may partition work, but the logical optimizer step must still represent the intended data and synchronized state. A failed partial step must not be published.

questions.question: What is the core correctness invariant of an MoE layer?
options: Every token must execute every expert
Every admitted token must complete the intended available expert paths within capacity and return one correctly weighted result
Every expert must receive exactly the same token text
Only the router must fit in accelerator memory
questions.explanation: Sparse execution is correct only when admitted assignments reach available experts, stay within the defined capacity behavior, and recombine into the right token output.

questions.question: At 20K requests per second and an 80% cache hit rate, how many requests reach the model?
options: 4K per second
16K per second
20K per second
80 per second
questions.explanation: The 20% miss branch is 0.20 x 20,000 = 4,000 model executions per second.

questions.question: What does “unified” mean in a healthy AI platform?
options: Consistent identity, metadata, interfaces, evidence, and operations across supported workflows
One model framework and one serving runtime for every workload
A single production cluster with no tenant boundaries
A developer portal that owns every application outcome
questions.explanation: The platform unifies durable contracts. It can support several implementations when they preserve those contracts.

questions.question: Why should a function launch a durable training job instead of training inline?
options: The managed job can outlive function time and memory limits
Functions provide infinite accelerators
Training has no durable state
Inline work prevents retries
questions.explanation: Short-lived functions are useful control-plane handlers; durable compute owns long-running ML work.
